definitions.explanation: The plant that produces rice grains.

definitions.gloss: rice crop (the standing rice of a field)
definitions.explanation: Rice as it grows in the field.

notes:
{稲|いね} refers specifically to the rice plant as it grows in paddy fields. Japanese has distinct words for rice at each stage of processing, and {稲|いね} covers the living plant.

RICE TERMINOLOGY:
- {稲|いね}: rice plant (growing in the field)
- ⟦{籾|もみ}→籾：noentry⟧: unhulled rice (after harvest)
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧: brown rice (hulled but unpolished)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: rice (white, uncooked grain)
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: cooked rice, meal

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{稲|いね}{刈|か}り→稲刈り：05933_inekari⟧: rice harvesting
- ⟦{稲穂|いなほ}→稲穂：10175_inaho⟧: ear of rice
- ⟦{稲作|いなさく}→稲作：09494_inasaku⟧: rice cultivation
- ⟦{水稲|すいとう}→水稲：noentry⟧: wet-paddy rice

CULTURAL NOTE:
Rice cultivation has been central to Japanese culture for millennia. {稲|いね} appears in many place names and is associated with autumn harvest imagery. The drooping ⟦{稲穂|いなほ}→稲穂：10175_inaho⟧ is a symbol of abundance and humility.
